snapshot: Chicago Nikkei 225 futures settled at 62,110, up 2,690 versus Osaka. Cash equities reopened from Golden Week above the 60,000 line.
The Nikkei opened at 60,241 and by 09:06 JST had extended gains to more than 1,164 points.
U.S. equities rallied on AMD's outlook and the AI semiconductor theme, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq setting new highs.
Crude fell sharply on U.S.-Iran agreement hopes, while USD/JPY moved back toward the low 156s, easing the worst of the 'bad yen' pressure.
The tape is broadly risk-on, but the most actionable checks are still stock-specific: earnings, shareholder returns and activist filings from the holiday gap.

drivers.driver: U.S. AI strength and lower crude drove a post-holiday risk-on open
drivers.why_today: AMD's strong outlook lifted AI semiconductor names, while lower oil improved sentiment. The Nikkei reclaimed the 60,000 line and buying is concentrated in tech and reopening catch-up names.

drivers.driver: USD/JPY has pulled back, easing import-cost concerns
drivers.why_today: Dollar/yen fell into the low 156s, reducing the intervention and bad-yen concerns that dominated near 160. That helps both domestic-demand and external-demand sentiment.

drivers.driver: Earnings, shareholder returns and large-holder filings are driving individual names
drivers.why_today: Oasis' stake in Plus Alpha, strong guidance from ARE and DMG Mori, and buybacks at DTS and Alinco provide clear stock-specific catalysts to verify after the open.

deep_dive.title: Plus Alpha Consulting: test whether Oasis' 8.02% stake becomes more than an opening indication

lines: The core catalyst is Oasis Management's 8.02% holding and the inclusion of important proposals in the stated purpose.
Even in a strong post-holiday index rally, an activist filing can create a stock-specific reason to buy that is separate from index beta.
The May 1 large-shareholding filing showed Oasis' 8.02% stake, and the stock opened indicated higher on May 7.
Because the market is broadly risk-on after Golden Week, the key is whether turnover remains specific to this activist angle rather than only a Growth-sector rebound.
Can the stock stay near the top of the gainers list after the opening indication clears.
Does the important-proposal angle keep being priced as a capital-policy or operating-improvement story.
The filing fails to generate concrete proposal expectations.
Short-term money sells the opening premium quickly.
Without a visible proposal, activist-driven moves can remain mostly headline and positioning trades.
If capital crowds into mega-cap tech, smaller Growth names with special-situation catalysts can get overshadowed.
